card.name: Splits inside URLs and words
card.fires_on: Short pieces at a break point: the 'm' after 'www.' or a dot in web addresses, the space before a year in citations, and the middle of words like hypoglycemia.

modes.label: Web address pieces
modes.description: The letter m right after www or a dot in a URL or module path.

modes.label: Space before citation year
modes.description: The space after a comma following 'et al.' just before the year.

modes.label: Inside long words
modes.description: A middle piece of a long word, such as 'og' in hypoglycemia.

card.plain: It fires at odd break points, like inside web addresses, before a citation year, or in the middle of a long word.
